headline: Angola Bans Single-Use Plastics Nationwide
meta_description: Angola has begun enforcing a nationwide ban on everyday single-use plastics, including shopping bags, straws, and cotton buds.
summary_short: Angola has launched a nationwide ban on single-use plastics, eliminating thin shopping bags, straws, stirrers, and plastic-stemmed cotton buds from everyday use.
body:
Angola has begun enforcing a nationwide ban on everyday single-use plastics, marking a significant environmental step for the African nation. The ban includes thin shopping bags, plastic straws, stirrers, and plastic-stemmed cotton buds—items that have become ubiquitous in daily life across much of the world.

The move reflects growing momentum among countries working to reduce plastic waste and its impact on ecosystems. By targeting these specific, commonly used items, Angola is addressing some of the most pervasive sources of plastic pollution in households and businesses. The ban demonstrates how broader environmental commitments can take shape through concrete action on everyday products.
